title: Thirty Years After Gene Jarosewich: Exploring the Smithsonian Mineral Collection for New Microanalytical Reference Materials
content: Reference materials and standards are essential components of quantitative microbeam methods, as they facilitate instrumental calibration, ensure quality assurance (such as secondary standards), and enable inter-laboratory comparisons. Ideally the material will have undergone rigorous testing for micro-homogeneity and established reference composition through independent methods, including round robin assessments.
